{{Quote|Ah, gentlebeings! Welcome to the herdship ''Veldt''. What can I interest you in today? I have shimmersilks from Kala'uun, flatsculps from Oordo III, corusca stone jewelry from Bimmisaari, and much more.|Tredo Dopra|<ref name="Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Oordo III''' was a celestial body<ref name="Trilogy" /> in the [[Oordo system/Legends|Oordo system]], a part of the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Flatsculp/Legends|Flatsculps]] were produced there, with the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] chief [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Tredo Dopra]] of the [[Ithorian Herdship|herdship]] [[Veldt (Ithorian Herdship)|''Veldt'']] having acquired a number of the artworks by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Trilogy" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oordo III was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Trilogy" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Oordo [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Oordo III, in grid square M-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
